join hortbot 999 foobar 1

send_any

send_any

send_any

send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add Quote 5
send_any

no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote compact 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Compacted quotes 1 and above (0 affected).
